steps.name: Demo Home
steps.goal: Reach Home. If Apple Account Verification appears, tap Not Now. If the AI data notice appears, tap Agree and continue for this isolated demo fixture. Do not send a message.

steps.name: Notification opens the finding
steps.goal: Wait for the finding opened through its notification route. Do not tap an action.
steps.done: The finding has clear priority, context, reasoning and a suggested next step.

steps.name: Context opens the report
steps.goal: Tap the element labelled exactly Open Review open PRs report, 2 open findings. This is a link. Tap it to open the findings list. Do not tap Back.
steps.done: The report shows both findings from the same agent.
expect: 3 PRs waiting on review for over a day

steps.name: Finding without details
steps.goal: Tap the Weekly audit is ready finding card.
steps.done: The finding has a labeled priority and explains that there are no additional details.
expect: The agent did not include more details

steps.name: Return to the report
steps.goal: Tap the native Back button at the top left.

steps.name: Return to Home
steps.goal: Tap the native Back button at the top left.
steps.done: Home is visible. The notification context link did not create a repeated report in the stack.

steps.name: Old notification has a useful exit
steps.goal: Wait for the missing finding state.
steps.done: The screen explains that this finding is no longer open and offers the agent report.
expect: This finding is no longer open

steps.name: Open the detailed finding again
steps.goal: Tap the finding card titled 3 PRs waiting on review for over a day.
steps.done: The detailed finding is ready for its action.

steps.name: Failed launch keeps the finding open
steps.goal: Tap Start session once. This isolated demo transport intentionally returns no session id, so no agent or real work starts. Do not tap it again.
steps.done: An error explains the failed launch while the original finding stays visible.
expect: The session did not start. Please try again.
3 PRs waiting on review for over a day
